name: SpicetifyFM (Last.fm Scrobbler)
description: A pure in-app Last.fm scrobbler inspired by Pano Scrobbler — zero third-party apps or external servers required. Features native tracklist SCROBBLE column in playlists & liked songs, bottom-left Now Playing scrobble count badge, serverless Desktop Web Auth, saved per-track metadata edits, Regex & Remastered/Deluxe cleaners, artist/track blocklists, Local Files support, and an offline retry queue.
